losses.lost: any JSON value narrowed to any JSON object
losses.why: `DefaultDecl.value` is `unknown` in main.tsp and `{}` in DefaultDecl.json, and IR v1.1 has no any-type. The JsonObject lowering — kind record, fields [], unknownPolicy preserve — is the closest representable shape, and it admits strictly less than the schema does.

`OperationDecl.params` is named in required and carries no minItems, so it lowers to lower 0 and its derived presence is optional. IR v1.1 cannot express 'the member must be present and may be empty'.
